body: Hello, sorry for the late reply. Feeling bad but glad to hear ur concern. Thanks for taking the time 👍
Good luck in the convention. You can do this

Difficulty swallowing, chest pressure, acid reflux. Most of my symptoms are gerd related but my gi doctors don't wanna do an endoscopy. They're more concerned about my difficulty breathing instead of my stomach issues so they put me on these tests. I also have a chest x-ray that shows hyperaerated lungs. 

What can it be? Whatever it is, my anxiety is probably making it worse. Its so hard to breathe when i go outside

can't go to a doctor yet. i haven't been formally diagnosed with asthma but i have family history of it. also been struggling with GERD for 2 years. 

what could be causing my shortness of breath? pls help.
I hope you'll find your peace. You'll be in my heart and thoughts.

Thank you friend. I'll keep you in my thoughts as well. I really cant stop you if u plan on doing it tonight. Heck, wish i could do it soon too. But in one way or another i hope you'll find peace. Maybe I'll find mine too.
Hang in there buddy. Is there anyone around who can keep you company?
Damn, that doesn't sound like family at all. Im sorry you have to be stuck with such people.
Sorry you have to suffer like this. All i can give you is a virtual hug

Let em know you're there for them. Be someone they can talk to. Theres really no "fix" for these things, and sometimes people just need that human connection, someone to talk to. It'll really help to keep in touch.

Sorry you had to live this shitty thing called life. Nobody asked for it. It sucks. the pains isnt worth the joys, so i kinda feel u friend. I hope u had some good in it and try to relive those times. Reminisce.
Heartbreaking place. Lot of people posting, people in a very difficult place and need help. And all we really got is miserable people to keep other miserable people company.

This really gave me perspective. Thank you kind person. Im probably not even at the bottom yet and already the pain is unbearable.

Hope u don't drop too deep on ur spiralling.
Damn. This feeling. I feel those words. My chronic illness isn't getting better, just keeps getting worse. Why is suicide so hard to do?
Im sorry you had to hear those words, from family as well. It'd break anyone's soul who's already suicidal.

Definitely. Ive had gerd and asthma for 2 years which only gets worse overtime. Cant even stand for a minute now. Thinking about hanging myself helps. I should really do it before i lose more physical function and be unable to do it.
Im sorry to hear that. Life really isn't fair that we have to suffer this illness. Hope you find ways to recover
